identity.person_ref: same ActorRef with civil_person facet, never a replacement body or copied actor
identity.civil_agent_record: CivicAgent attached to existing sapient ActorRef not a duplicate actor

expression.noncapability_traits: validated species-specific coefficient or authored slot map; 0.7..1.3 only applies to ratio capacities

tradeoffs.strength: larger active load and muscle throughput require larger real movement/work energy and higher bounded basal demand
tradeoffs.fur_density: more insulation reduces cold load and increases heat shedding burden without enlarging fixed body envelope
tradeoffs.energy_storage_capacity: larger possible reserve is empty until fed and stored with explicit conversion loss
tradeoffs.fasting_tolerance: extends deprivation damage grace but does not pay movement or work energy
tradeoffs.fertility: more gestation opportunities require real productive parent nutrition nest and actual care
tradeoffs.lifespan_potential: higher possible lifespan does not clear accumulated injuries disease age work or current health

expression.gestation_direction: larger duration coefficient lengthens actual required conception-snapshotted work; UI states direction explicitly rather than always calling larger better
expression.sleep_direction: larger sleep_requirement means more required actual rest; not a generic positive buff
expression.illness_direction: higher immune/toxin/parasite capacity improves clearance within finite species caps, not an immune-all flag

inheritance.reproductive_role_at_birth: fixed species supported role policy with saved conception-domain draw or bee role plan; legal gender identity does not alter biological role

subspecies.profile_edit_preview_includes: existing Actor members plus unborn membership reservations and predicted capacity outcomes; inherited alleles and gestation clocks remain saved
subspecies.lower_population_limit_during_pregnancy: existing conception reservations remain valid admitted birth; only new entry reservations blocked
subspecies.founder_distribution: affects new player-authored founder allele sampling within species; legal births always use saved parental alleles rather than replacement founder samples
subspecies.subspecies_definition_count_limit: limits only new branch records not mutations existing genomes sapience or biological births with existing branch

world_population_limit_interface.value: map_SubspeciesRef_to_nonnegative_new_Actor_cap_default_empty; zero blocks new entry but preserves current members and committed birth reservations

phenotype_interface.functional_development: fixed species age-stage coefficients may reduce actual movement work reproductive and care capacity before maturity while adult body geometry stays unchanged; genes do not move fixed adulthood threshold
phenotype_interface.capacity_consumption_policy: all consumers read versioned PhenotypeCapacities exports; never re-express alleles or shared-profile formulas in TerrainNavigation ThermalExposure TaskEligibility or NeedsAndHealth
phenotype_interface.fatigue_recovery_is_actual_state_recover: export is bounded potential recovery rate; actual debt reduction requires actual safe rest SimTick and available real metabolic energy, does not reset debt on edit

physiology.state_unit_policy: absolute fixed-point game units with species profile conversion coefficients locked by world content version

energy_sources.maintenance_nonrecoverable: finite initial or supported safety energy; may pay maintenance thermal movement and bounded direct foraging needed to obtain existing real food; cannot convert into gestation new biomass milk wool egg meat or transferable feed reserve
energy_sources.productive_real_food: absorbed from uniquely consumed real food batch; may fund supported work gestation stored biomass or product conversion with finite yields and losses
energy_sources.lost_energy: explicit thermal basal excretion or failed conversion loss never refund or ItemBatch

physiology.structural_product_conversion: all product reserve formation requires productive real-food material/energy inputs, finite species yield limits and actual work/time; reserves reduced once on collection

health_load_formula.step: bounded_increment_from_actual_dose_minus_species_and_genetic_clearance; damage only above versioned threshold with per_tick_maximum
health_load_formula.sim_randomness: if needed saved contact-domain counter never render_rng
health_load_formula.transmission_rule: infection_spread gates new actual-source contact transmission only; existing infection course nutrition immune recovery wounds and care continue

aging_model.chronological_age: elapsed saved SimTick since birth including time under aging rule off
aging_model.biological_aging_work: saved accumulation when aging consequence enabled; off never rolls age backward
aging_model.lifespan_capacity: species-bounded potential setting threshold and decline rates not an age overwrite or immortal flag
aging_model.death: bounded health decline plus saved aging-domain hazard after profile threshold, one actor death commit no abrupt replay for off interval
aging_model.edit: recompute future threshold rates but preserve actual age work injuries and health

pain_and_sleep.pain_sensitivity: subjective signal multiplier on actual injury and stress; modifies warning rest seeking and willingness to risky work but never structural damage ability or real health
pain_and_sleep.sleep_requirement: within species fixed envelope sets required restorative sim-time per biological day; increases actual sleep debt when unmet independently of Light/Darkness
pain_and_sleep.rest_recovery_efficiency: decreases saved sleep debt per actual safe rest work with real nutrition and site comfort; never resets fatigue health or age on gene edit
pain_and_sleep.fatigue_recovery: separate physical fatigue recovery with actual rest and energy; not a second duplicate sleep_debt converter
pain_and_sleep.insufficient_sleep: bounded attention reaction work and learning penalties no free skipped labour or sudden scripted death
pain_and_sleep.episode_state: saved actual start due work and last_tick; hidden screen menu paused shader and wall_clock do not create rest
pain_and_sleep.low_pain_tradeoff: fewer subjective alarms may allow unsafe decisions but actual damaged limb body load and task limits still apply
pain_and_sleep.higher_rest_efficiency_tradeoff: requires actual restorative time and adequate productive energy, has finite species ceiling

physiology.bootstrap_foraging: initial maintenance can reach and directly consume existing legal food reserve; may not synthesize harvestable animal biomass or offspring reserve

animal_ecology.forage_alias: ForagePatch is GroundResourceRef forage subtype; one authoritative reserve, not separate duplicate stock
animal_ecology.bee_each_role_has_same_species: genetics and breeding role are separate immutable supported reproductive-role fields; no extra species per role
animal_ecology.predation_rule: animal_predation gates new ordinary-animal hunt initiation only; no retroactive prey restoration or biomass refund, sapient violence follows civil/war rules
animal_ecology.vegetation_rule: wild_vegetation_recovery gates new wild sapling candidates; existing tree bloom fruit and agriculture remain actual finite production

breeding.breeding_roles: fixed species reproductive role fields; no role change by gene editor or civic gender label
breeding.gestation_clock_bound: conception snapshots species/profile duration and work rate version; later parent/subspecies edits may affect maternal support but cannot reset pregnancy to free full progress or rewrite due clock
breeding.existing_reserved_birth_after_population: honor existing birth reservation with explicit over_limit state; new conception blocked
breeding.newborn_care: actual existing caregiver time warmth and consumed suitable real food; no caregiver or milk inventory created at birth

civilization_light.all_other_civil_qualifications_equal: same CivicAgent rules and species maturity; formal job or office still checks real language skill charter tools and route, never generic species ban
civilization_light.livestock_contracts: stop slaughter/forced breeding/product seizure reservations, preserve already transferred goods and actual debts, revalidate optional voluntary person contracts after capability and consent
